At the conclusion of the Interim Report, we emphasized the tentative nature of the proposed formula and directed our energies on further proceedings toward a determination of the proper parameters of that formula based on an evaluation of the economic data and analysis already of record in the interim proceeding and any additional information submitted during the period of public comment preliminary to the preparation of this final report.
Since the provisional findings of the Interim Report were of considerable significance to the public and the motor carrier and freight forwarder industries, we directed that a summary of the entire report be published in the Federal Register. Appended to the Interim Report was a draft environmental impact statement prepared in compliance with our responsibilities pursuant to the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 (NEPA), 42 U.S.C. $$4321-47 (1970). All interested parties were invited to file written comments relating to any of the topics discussed in either the Interim Report or the draft environmental impact statement, making any suggestions that might assist us in devising a better regulatory scheme so as to implement properly the relevant sections of the Interstate Commerce Act and to effectuate the public interest.
